paragraphs.text: 1. AGNI, life-power and fame are thine: thy fires blaze mightily, thou rich in wealth of beams!
paragraphs.original: अग्ने तव श्रवो वयो महि भ्राजन्ते अर्चयो विभावसो ।
paragraphs.translit: agne tava śravo vayo mahi bhrājante arcayo vibhāvaso |

paragraphs.text: Sage, passing bright, thou givest to the worshipper, with strength, the food that merits laud.
paragraphs.original: बृहद्भानो शवसा वाजमुक्थ्यं दधासि दाशुषे कवे
paragraphs.translit: bṛhadbhāno śavasā vājamukthyaṃ dadhāsi dāśuṣe kave

paragraphs.text: 2. With brilliant, purifying sheen, with perfect sheen thou liftest up thyself in light.
Thou, visiting both thy Mothers, aidest them as Son: thou joinest close the earth and heaven.
paragraphs.original: पुत्रो मातरा विचरन्नुपावसि पृणक्षि रोदसी उभे
paragraphs.translit: putro mātarā vicarannupāvasi pṛṇakṣi rodasī ubhe

paragraphs.text: 3. O Jatavedas, Son of Strength, rejoice thyself, gracious, in our fair hymns and songs.
In thee are treasured various forms of strengthening food, born nobly and of wondrous help.
4. Agni, spread forth, as Ruler, over living things: give wealth to us, Immortal God.
Thou shinest out from beauty fair to look upon: thou leadest us to conquering power.
paragraphs.original: स दर्शतस्य वपुषो वि राजसि पृणक्षि सानसिं क्रतुम्
paragraphs.translit: sa darśatasya vapuṣo vi rājasi pṛṇakṣi sānasiṃ kratum

paragraphs.text: 5. To him, the wise, who orders sacrifice, who hath great riches un der his control,
Thou givest blest award of good, and plenteous food, givest him wealth that conquers all.
paragraphs.original: रातिं वामस्य सुभगां महीमिषं दधासि सानसिं रयिम्
paragraphs.translit: rātiṃ vāmasya subhagāṃ mahīmiṣaṃ dadhāsi sānasiṃ rayim

paragraphs.text: 6. The men have set before them them for their welfare Agni, strong, visible to all, the Holy.
paragraphs.original: ऋतावानं महिषं विश्वदर्शतमग्निं सुम्नाय दधिरे पुरो जनाः ।
paragraphs.translit: ṛtāvānaṃ mahiṣaṃ viśvadarśatamagniṃ sumnāya dadhire puro janāḥ |

paragraphs.text: Thee, Godlike One, with ears to hear, most famous, men's generations magnify with praise-songs.
paragraphs.original: श्रुत्कर्णं सप्रथस्तमं त्वा गिरा दैव्यं मानुषा युगा
paragraphs.translit: śrutkarṇaṃ saprathastamaṃ tvā girā daivyaṃ mānuṣā yugā
